S.FORM: Where the Wild Things Are nu Amuhuan a kamu, sakatalawanay a aadupan nu niyadu' nu Sakizaya a kamu. kakiliman "sakatalawanay a aadupan nu niyadu'" u misulitay ci Mulisis·sangdake i 1963 mihcaan patahkal tu misulitan nu wawaay a nisulitan, 2009 mihcaan pasadumaen tu aadihan nu iga "sakatalawanay a aadupan nu niyadu'". "sakatalawanay a aadupan nu niyadu'"u nipacakay kina cudadan makaala tu 1900 aemang a cudadan, i Amuhuan pacakay kina cudadan makaala tu 1000 aemang a cudadan. nilacul nu makaylabuway a kungku tu sulit
S.PHON: wħərə tħə wi[r|ɾ]d tħiŋs arə nu amuħuan a kamu sakata[r|ɾ]awanaj a aadupan nu nijadu[ʔ|ʡ] nu sakizaja a kamu kaki[r|ɾ]iman sakata[r|ɾ]awanaj a aadupan nu nijadu[ʔ|ʡ] u misu[r|ɾ]itaj ʦi mu[r|ɾ]isissaŋdakə i **** miħʦaan pataħka[r|ɾ] tu misu[r|ɾ]itan nu wawaaj a nisu[r|ɾ]itan **** miħʦaan pasadumaən tu aadiħan nu iga sakata[r|ɾ]awanaj a aadupan nu nijadu[ʔ|ʡ] sakata[r|ɾ]awanaj a aadupan nu nijadu[ʔ|ʡ]u nipaʦakaj kina ʦudadan makaa[r|ɾ]a tu **** aəmaŋ a ʦudadan i amuħuan paʦakaj kina ʦudadan makaa[r|ɾ]a tu **** aəmaŋ a ʦudadan ni[r|ɾ]aʦu[r|ɾ] nu makaj[r|ɾ]abuwaj a kuŋku tu su[r|ɾ]it
